usedFor: Financial Cents holds clients and contacts, and Microsoft Excel receives a row for each through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Financial Cents, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new client becomes a table row you can sort and report from.

watchOut: “Delete Client” in Financial Cents also triggers “Add Row To Table”, so deletions append rows instead of removing them.
